description: This file defines the Coupon model class for the OpenCart admin module, providing methods to create, read, update, and delete coupon records, as well as manage associated products, categories, and histories.

classes.name: Coupon
classes.description: This class manages CRUD operations and related data handling for coupons in the OpenCart admin module.

methods.name: addCoupon
methods.description: Creates a new coupon record in the database with provided data, including associated products and categories if specified.

methods.name: editCoupon
methods.description: Updates an existing coupon record identified by coupon_id with new data and manages associated products and categories.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a coupon record.

methods.name: deleteCoupon
methods.description: Deletes a coupon record and associated products, categories, and histories from the database.

methods.name: getCoupon
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific coupon by coupon_id.

methods.name: getCouponByCode
methods.description: Fetches a coupon record based on its unique code.

methods.name: getCoupons
methods.description: Fetches a list of coupons with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: addProduct
methods.description: Associates a product with a coupon.

methods.name: deleteProducts
methods.description: Removes all product associations for a given coupon.

methods.name: deleteProductsByProductId
methods.description: Deletes coupon associations based on product ID.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves product IDs associated with a coupon.

methods.name: addCategory
methods.description: Associates a category with a coupon.

methods.name: deleteCategories
methods.description: Removes all category associations for a coupon.

methods.name: deleteCategoriesByCategoryId
methods.description: Deletes coupon associations based on category ID.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Retrieves category IDs associated with a coupon.

methods.name: getTotalCoupons
methods.description: Returns the total number of coupons in the database.

methods.name: getHistories
methods.description: Retrieves the history records associated with a coupon, with pagination.

methods.name: deleteHistories
methods.description: Deletes all history records for a specific coupon.

methods.name: getTotalHistories
methods.description: Returns the total count of history records for a coupon.
